tv.name: ESPN
tv.note: On YouTube TV. Also on WDSU 6 here in New Orleans.

news.headline: Three Saints defenders are out Monday night
news.summary: Kaden Elliss, Carl Granderson and Anfernee Jennings will all miss the Atlanta game with calf, ankle and knee injuries. Pete Werner and tight end Noah Fant might play.

news.headline: Kamara and Miller will carry the ball Monday night
news.summary: Travis Etienne is hurt, so Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller will do most of the running against Atlanta. Coach Kellen Moore said C.J. Donaldson will take the short, tough runs.

news.headline: Trombone Shorty will play at halftime Monday night
news.summary: Trombone Shorty and Orleans Avenue play at halftime, joined by Eric Church, Kirk Franklin, Juvenile, Cyril Neville and Ivan Neville. The Saints will also honor Steve Gleason and Curtis DeLoatch for the blocked punt twenty years ago.

news.headline: Vernell Brown is doubtful for the Missouri game
news.summary: Florida's leading receiver hurt his right knee against Ole Miss and is listed as doubtful for Saturday. Bailey Stockton is probable, so the Gators should have him back.

news.headline: Two Florida receivers are questionable for Saturday
news.summary: Vernell Brown III has a mild knee strain and Bailey Stockton has a sore back, and both are listed as questionable at Missouri. Coach Jon Sumrall said neither injury is serious.

news.headline: Jadan Baugh wins the top offensive award in the SEC
news.summary: The conference named Baugh its offensive player of the week after he ran for 142 yards and three touchdowns against Ole Miss. Two more Gators were honored: London Montgomery on special teams and Bryce Lovett on the offensive line.

news.headline: Winston Watkins leads LSU in catches
news.summary: Watkins has 20 catches for 314 yards and two touchdowns in four games, more catches than anyone else on the team. He came to LSU from Ole Miss, and his cousin Sammy Watkins won a Super Bowl.

news.headline: Landen Clark may start at quarterback Saturday
news.summary: Sam Leavitt still has a sore hamstring, so LSU may rest him against McNeese and start Clark instead. Coach Lane Kiffin said Clark has done a great job and finds ways to make plays.

news.headline: Trey'Dez Green hopes to play again on November 7
news.summary: The tight end hurt his knee against Ole Miss and does not need surgery. He is aiming to come back for the Alabama game in Baton Rouge on November 7.

news.headline: Freshman Trace Johnson takes over at quarterback
news.summary: Kadin Semonza threw an interception early in the fourth quarter on Saturday, so coach Will Hall sent in true freshman Trace Johnson. Johnson completed 2 of 5 passes for 35 yards and ran the offense while Tulane scored the last 10 points to win.

news.headline: Maurice Turner wins the conference weekly award
news.summary: Turner carried the ball 12 times for 200 yards and two touchdowns in Saturday's 24-21 win over Southern Miss, including the 74-yard run that put Tulane ahead. It is the first weekly honor of his career.

news.headline: Tulane wins the Battle for the Bell 24-21
news.summary: Maurice Turner ran for 200 yards Saturday at Yulman Stadium, and his 74-yard touchdown run with 5:26 left put Tulane ahead. TJ Smith then blocked a Southern Miss field goal to save the win for coach Will Hall against his old team.
